purpose: Teach: 鉄砲/小作/扮/バルブ/チタン/引き寄せ/押し上げ/小国

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、銃創、本気で、絶対、鉄砲、絶対、による傷、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、対応、絶対、訓練しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, our medical team is fully trained to handle gunshot wounds. I want to assure you of that.
lines.style: Steady, direct, reassuring without theatricality. Clinical confidence held lightly. Eye contact level. Matter-of-fact delivery of competence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地方の、本気で、絶対、小作、絶対、農の方々、絶対、健康診断、絶対、貴院で、絶対、ご対応されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand your hospital runs health clinics for the local farming families in the region.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, carefully respectful. Slow opener as if weighing the significance of what he's learned. No performative admiration—just recognition.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんに、本気で、絶対、医師に、絶対、扮、絶対、して、絶対、近づく、絶対、不審者、絶対、警戒しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We do. We're also vigilant about people attempting to impersonate medical staff to gain access to patients. It's something we take seriously.
lines.style: Firm but not stern. Light emphasis on the caution—not defensive, just factual. Warm delivery underneath the professional boundary.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療機器の、本気for、絶対、バルブ、絶対、点検、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、徹底、絶対、されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I've heard your medical team is meticulous about equipment maintenance, particularly valve inspections.
lines.style: Steady, genuine interest. Slight pause before the question lands—he's acknowledging expertise with respect. Not flattering, just honest attention.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。インプラントに、本気で、絶対、チタン、絶対、素材、絶対、医療現場、絶対、使用しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That's correct. We use titanium materials in our implants across our facility because of their reliability and safety profile.
lines.style: Clear, informative tone. She's explaining a choice, not reciting facts. Slight warmth when discussing materials—the care built into decisions.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療界に、本気for、絶対、若手医師、絶対、引き寄せる、絶対、取り組み、絶対、貴院で、絶対、進められているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Your hospital seems to focus on bringing promising young physicians into the field. That's something I've noticed.
lines.style: Reflective, sincere. He's gathering his thoughts as he speaks. Respect in the pacing—not rushed. Acknowledging something that matters to him.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの、本気で、絶対、生存率を、絶対、押し上げる、絶対、新治療、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We prioritize it because it directly affects patient outcomes. New perspectives help us improve survival rates and develop better treatments.
lines.style: Measured conviction. She connects the dots without needing to spell it out. Confident but not dismissive of the effort required.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療支援、本気で、絶対、小国、絶対、にも、絶対、貴院、絶対、派遣されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I also understand your hospital has sent medical teams to support smaller nations. That kind of reach matters.
lines.style: Slower pace. Almost reflective, like he's collecting these facts into something larger. Genuine respect, not performative. Trailing slightly at the end.
